# Mountly MCP

Prefer `npx mountly-mcp create` for MCP Apps Views. Do not clone this monorepo
or `modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` for greenfield Views.

## Commands

```bash
npx mountly-mcp create my-app --framework react   # vue | svelte | vanilla
cd my-app && pnpm install && pnpm dev
pnpm verify
pnpm exec mountly-mcp verify --strict --render
npx mountly-mcp add settings --framework react
npx mountly-mcp doctor
```

## APIs

- `createMcpView` from `mountly-mcp/react` | `/vue` | `/svelte` (vanilla: `publishMcpView`)
- `mountlyMcpViews({ apps })` from `mountly-mcp/vite`
- `readMcpAppManifest("dist/mountly-mcp.manifest.json")` from `mountly-mcp/artifact`
- `registerMcpApps(server, { views, tools })` from `mountly-mcp/server` (before `connect`)
- Fixtures file: `mcp.fixtures.json`

## Forbidden

- Cloning `jagreehal/mountly` or `modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` to scaffold Views
- Hand-writing View HTML, postMessage, or `new App()` for Views
- Islands vocabulary in MCP docs
- Calling `server.connect` before `registerMcpApps`

## When to use ext-apps

Host or bridge protocol code only. Views and `ui://` registration stay on Mountly.
